findings.message: End-of-life '2027-04-16' exceeds 3-month cap (today + 3 months = 2027-01-16) for upstream-sourced application without accepted support plan. Submit support plan for human review or reduce EOL date to 3 months or less from 2026-10-16.

summary: Recipe patch version update from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1 with no structural changes to parts, services or packages. EOL violation blocks release pending support plan acceptance or date adjustment.
